properties.text: Chat - remote images in a transcript. An agent's Markdown can use an image URL to send data out when a message renders, so remoteImages covers every Markdown surface: messages, thoughts, tool-call details and captions. Open the tool card to see its image.
remoteImages "on-click": placeholders name each image's host; click one to fetch it.

message.text: Show me a chart of last quarter.
A picture in a thought is held too: ![thought picture](https://picsum.photos/seed/actionui-chat-onclick-thought/240/160)

Here it is:

![quarterly chart](https://picsum.photos/seed/actionui-chat-onclick-message/480/320)
